umi10pcr7er05 <- read.csv("./umi10pcr7er05_ivar.csv", row.names=1)

#create variant ID
umi10pcr7er05$variant <- paste0(umi10pcr7er05$REF, umi10pcr7er05$POS, umi10pcr7er05$ALT)

Simulation of HIV population with UMI of 10nt, with 0.5% error rate, and 7 PCR amplification cycles. Below is the comparison of SNV detection when the ground truth in 30,000 sequence templates is: 0.01% freq (3 templates) A176G T250A C413T 0.1% freq (30 templates) A527C T574C T795A 1% freq (300 templates) A747G A852G C714A

FP= false positives, FN= false negatives, and TP= true positives were calculated per replicate (three replicates in total) and then precision, recall and F1 score were calculated using average F1 score: if F1 = 1 precision and recall are perfect, if F1 = 0 total fail detecting real positves

#ground truth variants and expected frequencies
true_variants <- c("A176G", "A527C", "A747G", "A852G", "C413T", "C714A", "T250A", "T574C", "T795A")

umi10pcr7er05_summary_by_replicate <- umi10pcr7er05 %>% 
  group_by(tool, replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    TP = sum(variant %in% true_variants),
    FP = sum(!(variant %in% true_variants)),
    FN = length(true_variants) - TP,
    Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
    Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
    F1 = 2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

umi10pcr7er05_metrics_summary <- umi10pcr7er05_summary_by_replicate %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_Precision = mean(Precision),
    sd_Precision = sd(Precision),
    mean_Recall = mean(Recall),
    sd_Recall = sd(Recall),
    mean_F1 = mean(F1),
    sd_F1 = sd(F1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

umi10pcr7er05_metrics_summary

# Ground truth variants
true_variants <- c("A176G", "A527C", "A747G", "A852G", 
                   "C413T", "C714A", "T250A", "T574C", "T795A")

# Consenso: mantener variantes detectadas en >= 2 replicados
umi10pcr7er05_consensus <- umi10pcr7er05 %>%
  group_by(tool, variant) %>%
  summarise(n_reps = n_distinct(replicate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_reps >= 2)

# Evaluar métricas por tool
umi10pcr7er05_metrics_consensus <- umi10pcr7er05_consensus %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    TP = sum(variant %in% true_variants),
    FP = sum(!(variant %in% true_variants)),
    FN = length(true_variants) - TP,
    Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
    Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
    F1 = ifelse((Precision + Recall) == 0, 0,
                2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

umi10pcr7er05_metrics_consensus

true_freqs <- data.frame(
  variant = c("A176G", "A527C", "A747G", "A852G", "C413T", "C714A", "T250A", "T574C", "T795A"),
  simulated_freq = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.01, 0.0001, 0.01, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.001)
) %>%
  mutate(freq_label = factor(simulated_freq,
                             levels = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01),
                             labels = c("0.01%", "0.1%", "1%")))
#observed frequencies
ivar_tp <- umi10pcr7er05 %>%
  filter(variant %in% true_freqs$variant)

observed_freqs_by_rep <- ivar_tp %>%
  group_by(tool, variant, replicate) %>%
  summarise(observed_freqs = mean(ALT_FREQ), .groups = 'drop')

#combine freq observed with expected freq
freq_comparacion <- left_join(observed_freqs_by_rep, true_freqs, by = "variant")

freq_summary <- freq_comparacion %>%
  group_by(tool, variant, simulated_freq, freq_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_observed = mean(observed_freqs),
    sd_observed = sd(observed_freqs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#plot observed vs expected freq
freq_summary$tool <- factor(freq_summary$tool, levels = c(
  "UMI-tools", 
  "UMICollapse", 
  "RUMINA-singletons",
  "RUMINA_directional", 
  "RUMINA_acyclic", 
  "RUMINA_raw", 
  "RUMINA_nolength"
))

truepositives <- ggplot(freq_summary, aes(x = variant, y = mean_observed, color = tool)) + 
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_observed - sd_observed,
                    ymax = mean_observed + sd_observed),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                width = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.00005, 0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.015),
                labels = c("0.005%", "0.01%", "0.05%", "0.1%", "0.5%", "1%", "1.5%")) +
  facet_wrap(~freq_label, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(subtitle = "Expected freq", x= "", y = "Observed frequency (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.00004, 0.02)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "UMI-tools" = "#fdd768",              # Yellow
    "UMICollapse" = "#e06f4f",            # Orange
    "RUMINA-singletons" = "#619cff",       # Blue
    "RUMINA_directional" = "#808080",     # Gray
    "RUMINA_acyclic" = "#f49dc9",         # Pink
    "RUMINA_raw" = "red",             # Red
    "RUMINA_nolength" = "#00bb7b"      # Green
  ))

print(truepositives)

#analysis per tool per condition
evaluate_df <- function(df, tool, condition) {
  called <- df %>% distinct(variant, replicate)
  
  eval <- true_freqs %>%
    crossing(replicate = unique(df$replicate)) %>%
    left_join(called, by = c("variant", "replicate")) %>%
    mutate(detected = !is.na(replicate)) %>%
    group_by(freq_label, replicate) %>%
    summarise(
      TP = sum(detected),
      FN = sum(!detected),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(tool = tool, condition = condition)

#FP per replicate
  fp_per_replicate <- df %>%
    filter(!(variant %in% true_freqs$variant)) %>%
    group_by(replicate) %>%
    summarise(FP = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  eval <- eval %>%
    left_join(fp_per_replicate, by = "replicate") %>%
    mutate(FP = ifelse(is.na(FP), 0, FP)) %>%
    mutate(
      Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
      Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
      F1 = ifelse((Precision + Recall) == 0, 0, 2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall))
    )

  return(eval)
}

#run for all conditions per tools
results_all <- map_dfr(names(all_conditions), function(cond_name) {
  df_cond <- all_conditions[[cond_name]]
  
  tools <- unique(df_cond$tool)
  
  map_dfr(tools, function(tool_name) {
    df_tool <- df_cond %>% filter(tool == tool_name)
    evaluate_df(df_tool, tool = tool_name, condition = cond_name)
  })
})

#plotting recall
truepos_pertool_perreplicate <- ggplot(results_all, aes(x = freq_label, y = Recall, color = tool)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = replicate), width = 0.1, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(stat = "summary", fun = mean, aes(group = tool), size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ condition) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(subtitle = "Puntos = réplicas individuales; líneas = media por tool",
    x = "Frecuencia esperada", y = "Recall")

# Tabla de FPs por variante, herramienta, condición y réplica
fp_variants <- all_conditions_df %>%
  filter(!(variant %in% true_freqs$variant)) %>%
  group_by(condition, tool, replicate) %>%
  summarise(fp_variants = list(unique(variant)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest(fp_variants)

# Contar en cuántas réplicas aparece cada FP
fp_summary_replicates <- fp_variants %>%
  group_by(condition, tool, fp_variants) %>%
  summarise(n_replicates = n_distinct(replicate), .groups = "drop")

# Quedarse solo con los que aparecen en ≥2 réplicas
fp_summary_filtered <- fp_summary_replicates %>%
  filter(n_replicates >= 2)

# Contar cuántos FP hay por condición y tool
fp_counts_by_tool_condition <- fp_summary_filtered %>%
  group_by(condition, tool) %>%
  summarise(FP_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(condition, tool)

From the dataset of 13 PCR cicles I obtained >200M reads. I downsampled to 6M for the previous testing, but here I also downsampled to 1.5M reads, 3M reads, and 12M reads and then used those as input to test memory and runtime scalability of the tools:

hiv_scalability <- read.csv("./bench_hiv-scalability_2025-08-29_15_50_23.csv")

#Runtime
hiv_scalability_runtime <- hiv_scalability %>%
  group_by(Tool, Inputreads) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanRuntime = mean(Runtime),
    SDRuntime = sd(Runtime),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

runtime_plot <- ggplot(hiv_scalability_runtime, aes(x = Inputreads, y = MeanRuntime, color = Tool)) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  geom_point(size=5) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, breaks = unique(hiv_scalability_runtime$Inputreads)) +
  labs(x = "Input Reads", y = "Mean Runtime (min)") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16, family = "helvetica"), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, family = "helvetica"))

# Memory
hiv_scalability_memory <- hiv_scalability %>%
  group_by(Tool, Inputreads) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanMemory = mean(Peakmemoryused),
    SDMemory = sd(Peakmemoryused),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

memory_plot <- ggplot(hiv_scalability_memory, aes(x = Inputreads, y = MeanMemory, color = Tool)) +
    geom_line(size=1) +
    geom_point(size=5) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, breaks = unique(hiv_scalability_memory$Inputreads)) +
    labs(x = "Input Reads",y = "Peak Memory (GB)") +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16, family = "helvetica"), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, family = "helvetica"))

#Iteration variability
hiv_scalability_summary <- hiv_scalability %>%
    group_by(Tool, Inputreads) %>%
    summarise(
        mean_memory = mean(Peakmemoryused),
        sd_memory = sd(Peakmemoryused),
        mean_runtime = mean(Runtime),
        sd_runtime = sd(Runtime),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
